blocks.html: For many Filipinos abroad, owning a home in the Philippines is more than a property investment—it is a source of security, a foundation for their family’s future, and a decision they hope will hold value through changing times.

This shared understanding was at the center of a new partnership between RLC Residences, the residential arm of Robinsons Land Corporation, and Bahaideals.com. Through the collaboration, the two organizations aim not only to make Philippine homeownership opportunities more accessible to Filipinos who currently work or stay in the United States and Canada, but also to provide the clarity, guidance, and confidence they need to make informed decisions about their future.

Bahaideals.com is a digital real estate platform that helps overseas Filipinos explore property opportunities in the Philippines through verified listings, property guidance, and home financing support.

The agreement was signed on May 27, 2026, at Cyberscape Alpha in Ortigas, led by Teddy V. Bernas, Senior Vice President and Business Unit General Manager of RLC Residences, and Keny Chang, President and CEO of Bahaideals.com. The partnership brings together the thoughtfully designed residential portfolio of RLC Residences, and Bahaideals.com’s digital platform for global Filipinos seeking reliable property opportunities in the Philippines.

“At RLC Residences, we believe home ownership should bring lasting investment value, and peace of mind,” said Bernas. “Our shared mission with Bahaideals.com is to help more Filipinos abroad make informed and confident decisions as they build a future for themselves and their loved ones.” He added that RLC Residences are able to provide the comfort and the security the future homeowner is currently seeking.

The partnership reflects a shared commitment to helping overseas Filipinos navigate the homebuying journey with greater confidence. By combining trusted property expertise with digital accessibility, both organizations aim to simplify the process and reduce the uncertainty that often comes with purchasing a home from abroad.
This collaboration supports RLC Residences’ international marketing initiatives by providing Filipino communities in the US and Canada a

clearer way to learn about its residential developments. It also allows Bahaideals.com users to discover homes from one of the Philippines leading property developers, with projects designed around location, livability, and everyday priorities of modern Filipino families.

“Many Filipinos abroad dream of owning a home in the Philippines, but distance can make the process feel complicated and uncertain,” said Denise Lyttle-Lao, Vice President and Overall Head of Sales of RLC Residences. “Overseas buyers are carefully evaluating their options and looking for trusted partners who can help them make confident decisions about their future. Through this partnership, we hope to give them greater confidence that homeownership in the Philippines can be achievable, secure, and supported every step of the way.”

Representatives from both organizations also discussed how the partnership can support overseas Filipinos at different stages of the homebuying journey. Chang highlighted Bahaideals.com’s role in helping global Filipinos explore property options from wherever they are, while Bernas underscored the opportunity to bring RLC Residences’ developments closer to Filipino communities overseas.

Among those present from Bahaideals.com were Ana Alvarez, Director of Commercial Operations; Kenneth Quezada, Sales Director; Karlo Morales, Chief Marketing Officer; and Paula Beltran, Head of Digital Marketing.

Through this partnership, RLC Residences and Bahaideals.com hope to make the dream of owning a home in the Philippines feel closer, more attainable, and easier to navigate for Filipinos abroad. It also reflects RLC Residences’ continuing commitment to helping Filipinos everywhere make confident decisions about their future, supported by trusted guidance and a home they can truly call their own.
